text: Alliance About & Governance 🐧 CHERI Linux WG 🐧 CHERI Linux WG Coordinates priorities, cross-architecture requirements, implementation experience, and contribution routes for CHERI support in Linux. The CHERI Linux Working Group defines and prioritises a roadmap for the porting of Linux to CHERI, while stimulating open-source communities to work on these element. The technical CHERI Linux page explains the wider software stack and current development.
